name: Lashing Out In Anger
overview: Scripture teaches that lashing out in anger is to be avoided, urging believers to cease from wrath and not to fret themselves into doing evil. The wisdom of Proverbs highlights the value of being slow to anger, associating it with great understanding, discretion, and strength greater than that of the mighty. A gentle response can defuse anger, while harsh words and a wrathful spirit only provoke strife. Christians are called to exercise self-control over their emotions, demonstrating humility and patience by passing over offenses rather than hastily reacting in anger.
